description: Premium stats/social proof, Why SKF features, and testimonials auto-carousel. steps: INSPECT services component: Read src/app/components/services/services.ts, services.html, services.css in full. In services.ts, add stats array and implement IntersectionObserver in ngAfterViewInit to trigger count-up animation when stats-row enters viewport (similar pattern to app.ts initScrollReveal). Add animateCounter() method that increments from 0 to target with requestAnimationFrame. Import AfterViewInit, ViewChild, ElementRef. Style in services.css: stats-row grid (4 columns), stat-card with glassmorphism (background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08), backdrop-filter: blur(12px)), counter number (font-size: 3rem, font-weight: 800, color: #2563EB), label below (font-size: 0.85rem, color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7)). INSPECT philosophy component: Read src/app/components/philosophy/philosophy.html and .css. Document: centered blockquote with philosophy-quote class, quote text about strength, philosophy-highlight span on 'yourself'. PRESERVE: quote text content, centered layout. CHANGE: rename section id from 'philosophy' to 'why-skf', add section-eyebrow above quote ('WHY SKF FITNESS?'), add section-subtitle below quote ('Four reasons members choose us and stay'). Keep existing philosophy.css quote styling.

INSPECT approach and method components: Read approach.html/.css and method.html/.css. Document existing content and styling. DECISION: Keep these as separate sections (approach, method) rather than combining. They serve different purposes: approach shows philosophy statement, method shows 3-step process with images. DO NOT combine or remove these sections. Instead, create a NEW separate 'features' or 'why-choose-us' section between method and categories in app.ts component order.

CREATE new Why SKF features section: In src/app/components/, create a new standalone component 'features' (or use existing if one exists). In app.ts, import and add <app-features> between method and categories. In features.html, create 4-column grid with numbered feature cards: 01—Expert Coaching (dumbbell icon), 02—Science-Backed Training (activity icon), 03—Real Community (users icon), 04—Track Your Progress (trending-up icon). Each card: span.feature-number ('01'), div.icon-badge (use existing class from styles.css, blue circle 56px), h3.feature-title, p.feature-description. In features.css: 4-column grid on desktop, 2-col on tablet, 1-col on mobile. Premium spacing (gap: 2rem), minimal borders, clean typography. Use existing design tokens.

INSPECT testimonials component: Read testimonials.ts, .html, .css in full. Document: testimonials[] array with 3 items (id, name, text, achievement, image), currentIndex = 0, currentTestimonial getter, nextTestimonial/previousTestimonial/goToTestimonial methods, manual navigation with arrows and dots. PRESERVE: all existing methods, testimonials data, navigation buttons. ADD: auto-play interval in ngOnInit (store in private intervalId: any), call nextTestimonial every 5000ms, clear interval in ngOnDestroy, reset interval on user interaction (prev/next/dot clicks). ADD: CSS transition for fade effect on testimonial-card (.testimonial-card { transition: opacity 0.3s ease; } .testimonial-card.fading { opacity: 0; }). In TypeScript, add brief fade-out/fade-in cycle when changing testimonial. VERIFY: star color is #F59E0B in testimonials.css .star class.

ADD trust badge to testimonials: In testimonials.html, above testimonial-navigation div, add a trust-badge div: '
★ 4.9/5 from 500+ members
'. Style in testimonials.css: center-aligned, font-size 0.85rem, color rgba(255,255,255,0.7), background rgba(255,255,255,0.06), backdrop-filter blur(8px), padding 0.5rem 1.5rem, border-radius 24px, margin-bottom 1rem, display inline-block.

VERIFY TypeScript compilation: Run 'npx ng build --configuration development' from fitusion folder. Check terminal for errors. If TypeScript errors in services.ts or testimonials.ts (missing imports, type errors), fix immediately. If template errors (missing properties, wrong syntax), fix in HTML. Document any errors and fixes in findings.

MANUAL TESTING: Start dev server 'npx ng serve', open localhost:4200. Scroll to services section: verify 4 stat counters appear and animate from 0 to target when scrolled into view. Scroll to Why SKF: verify philosophy quote is preserved, new features section (if created) shows 4 numbered cards. Scroll to testimonials: wait 5 seconds and verify testimonial auto-advances with smooth fade. Click prev/next arrows and verify manual navigation still works. Open browser console and check for errors.
